residual risks must be carried forward into downstream confidence and interpretation."],"needs_continuation":false,"reviewer_summary":"Terminal no-search review after all permitted research rounds. The notebook contains substantial cited evidence and improved contrary coverage, but it remains incomplete for fair ruler-period presentation: formal authority often exceeds personal attribution, closed-system silence limits inference, and several selected lenses lack precise remedy, implementation, personal-integrity, command-control, or event-level evidence.
